tagline.zh: columns: 4 220px 一行声明把内容分成多栏,内容沿列流动形成瀑布流——零 JS、全平台可用,是 grid-lanes 的成熟兜底;代价是顺序按列排布。
tagline.en: columns: 4 220px splits content into columns in one declaration; content flows down the columns into a masonry — zero JS, works everywhere, the mature fallback for grid-lanes; the trade-off is column-wise ordering.

origin.zh: 出自 CSS Multi-column Layout:该模块可将内容分栏,定义列数/列宽、列间距与分隔线;「每个列盒是一个片段(与分页媒体相似)」,内容**沿列流动**;核心属性 columns / column-count / column-width / column-gap / column-rule / column-span,断行用 break-inside(fragmentation 模块);核心属性早已全平台广泛支持;Level 2 的 column-height、column-wrap、::column 等仍在草案阶段(调研 11§4A)。
origin.en: From CSS Multi-column Layout: the module splits content into columns, defining column count/width, gaps and rules; "each column box is a fragment (like paged media)" and content **flows down the columns**; core properties columns / column-count / column-width / column-gap / column-rule / column-span, with break-inside (fragmentation module) controlling breaks; core properties enjoy platform-wide support; Level 2's column-height, column-wrap and ::column remain drafts (research 11 §4A).

effect.zh: column-width(列宽下限)。默认 220px 取自调研 11§4B 可复用片段 columns: 4 220px;列宽是下限而非精确值——浏览器按容器宽度尽量多排列,实际列数 = 能塞下多少塞多少。
effect.en: column-width (the column minimum). Default 220px from the research 11 §4B snippet columns: 4 220px; the width is a floor, not an exact value — the browser packs as many columns as the container allows.

effect.zh: column-gap(列间距)。默认 16px 取自同一片段(调研 11§4B 记载 column-gap: 16px)。
effect.en: column-gap. Default 16px from the same snippet (research 11 §4B records column-gap: 16px).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 切换 data-rule)。对应 column-rule 分隔线能力——报章式分栏的视觉语言;瀑布流卡片墙通常关闭,多栏正文可开启。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo toggles data-rule). Maps to the column-rule capability — the visual language of newspaper columns; card walls usually turn it off, multi-column prose may turn it on.

note.zh: 多列核心属性(columns / column-count / column-width / column-gap / column-rule / column-span)早已全平台广泛可用(调研 11§4A);Level 2 的 column-height、column-wrap、::column 仍在草案阶段,勿依赖(调研 11§4A)。
note.en: The multi-column core properties (columns / column-count / column-width / column-gap / column-rule / column-span) have enjoyed platform-wide support for a long time (research 11 §4A); Level 2's column-height, column-wrap and ::column remain drafts — do not rely on them (research 11 §4A).

fallback.zh: 无需回退——columns 本身就是回退方案(grid-lanes 的全平台兜底,调研 11§4B);极老环境不支持时内容单列纵排可读;break-inside: avoid 不被支持时卡片可能被拦腰截断,可用 min-height 或内容分区缓解。注意 fragmentainer 陷阱:卡片内不要放 position: fixed/absolute 元素跨列。
fallback.en: No fallback needed — columns IS the fallback (the all-platform safety net for grid-lanes, research 11 §4B); on ancient engines content stacks in one readable column; without break-inside: avoid cards may be sliced mid-card, mitigable with min-height or content zoning. Mind the fragmentainer trap: don't put position: fixed/absolute elements inside cards spanning columns.

use.zh: 零 JS 图片墙/引用墙——一行 columns 声明得到瀑布流,无库无计算
use.en: Zero-JS image/quote walls — one columns declaration yields a masonry, no libraries or math

use.zh: 报章式正文分栏——多列模块的设计初衷,配合 column-rule 与 column-span(首栏大标题)
use.en: Newspaper-style prose columns — the module's founding purpose, with column-rule and column-span (full-width headlines)

use.zh: 作为 grid-lanes 的全平台兜底(调研 11§4B 片段原样)——未来一行声明升级泳道
use.en: As the all-platform fallback for grid-lanes (verbatim from the research 11 §4B snippet) — one declaration upgrades to lanes later

use.zh: 高度不一但顺序不敏感的内容集合(标签云、词卡、推荐位)
use.en: Uneven-height but order-insensitive collections (tag clouds, word cards, promo slots)

avoid.zh: 按行序阅读的列表——卡片顺序按列排布(自上而下再换列),MDN 明确列为局限(调研 11§4A)
avoid.en: Lists read in row order — items flow down columns (top-to-bottom, then next column); MDN lists this as a limitation (research 11 §4A)

avoid.zh: 交互密集的卡片流——列内顺序与 Tab 顺序错位,键盘用户困惑
avoid.en: Interaction-heavy card feeds — in-column order diverges from Tab order, confusing keyboard users

avoid.zh: 需要动态插入到顶部的社交流——columns 无法控制条目落点,插入会重排整栏
avoid.en: Social feeds that prepend items — columns cannot control placement, inserts re-flow whole columns

avoid.zh: 依赖 Level 2 特性(column-height / column-wrap / ::column)——仍在草案,勿生产使用(调研 11§4A)
avoid.en: Relying on Level 2 features (column-height / column-wrap / ::column) — still drafts, not for production (research 11 §4A)

a11y.zh: DOM 顺序 = 栏序(自上而下),读屏顺序与「从左到右读行」的视觉直觉不一致(WCAG 1.3.2 语义顺序)——顺序敏感内容须改用 Grid;列数随容器变化时 Tab 顺序随之变化,焦点不可预测感是真实成本;column-span: all 的元素打断了列流,读屏顺序仍按 DOM——核对跨列标题前后的信息连续性;卡片内禁用跨列的 fixed/absolute 定位元素。
a11y.en: DOM order = column order (top-to-bottom), which diverges from the left-to-right visual reading of rows (WCAG 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence) — order-sensitive content must move to Grid; Tab order changes as the column count changes with the container, and that unpredictability is a real cost; column-span: all elements interrupt the column flow while screen-reader order stays DOM-based — check information continuity across spanning headlines; no position: fixed/absolute elements inside cards spanning columns.

goal.zh: 复刻零 JS 多列瀑布流:columns: auto <colMin> 声明列宽下限,column-gap 控制间距,卡片 break-inside: avoid 防截断,顺序徽标(01…09)直观展示「按列排布」的顺序语义。
goal.en: Replicate a zero-JS multi-column masonry: columns: auto <colMin> for the width floor, column-gap for spacing, cards with break-inside: avoid, and order badges (01…09) making the column-wise order semantics visible.

acceptance.zh: columns 与 column-gap 严格使用参数快照值;列宽作为下限使用(不写死列数)
acceptance.en: columns and column-gap use the exact parameter snapshot values; width acts as a floor (no hard-coded column count)

acceptance.zh: 卡片应用 break-inside: avoid,多列内容不被拦腰截断
acceptance.en: Cards apply break-inside: avoid so column content never slices through a card

acceptance.zh: 顺序徽标如实展示按列排布语义,不伪装行序
acceptance.en: Order badges honestly show the column-wise ordering; never fake row order

acceptance.zh: 不使用 Level 2 草案特性(column-height / column-wrap / ::column)
列数变化时内容仍完整可达,卡片内无跨列 fixed/absolute 元素
acceptance.en: Content stays fully reachable as the column count changes; no fixed/absolute elements spanning columns inside cards
